Metadata.description: Typing races between friends, inspired by Rocket League.

Design.heroDescription: Turn every keystroke into a little more speed. Bring your friends, find your rhythm, and take your ball all the way to the goal.
Design.visualCaption: ONE CAR. ONE BALL. YOUR RACE.
Design.typeDescription: Every correct character moves you forward. Find your flow and keep it going.
Design.boostDescription: Across the pitch, up the wall, onto the ceiling. This is no ordinary straight line.
Design.scoreDescription: Your own car. Your own ball. Complete the text to send it into the net.
Design.authHeadline: A little less scrolling. A lot more scoring.
Design.authDescription: A typing playground with a car-soccer soul. Your next race starts at the keyboard.
Design.logInDescription: Your place on the starting line is waiting.
Design.signUpDescription: Pick a name. Make it yours on the pitch.
Design.lobbiesDescription: Jump into an open room or bring your own crew.
Design.firstRace: Be the first on the pitch
Design.joinDescription: Got an invite? Enter your friend’s race code below.
Design.warmUpDescription: Get a feel for the stadium with our solo race preview.
Design.createDescription: Open the gates to everyone or keep the code between friends.
Design.inviteDescription: Create your room to get a six-character code. Share it with your friends so they can join you.
Design.roomDescription: The crew is gathering. Your arena is ready.
Design.shareCode: Share this code with your friends. They can enter it on the race browser.
Design.raceComing: You can gather in this room now. Multiplayer racing is still in development.
Design.previewSeparate: Want to test the driving concept? The solo preview runs separately from this room.

Race.title: Meet your new racetrack.
Race.description: Type to push your ball across the pitch, up the wall, and into a ceiling shot. This preview is local and does not save results.
Race.prompt: Your keyboard is the engine. Find your rhythm, climb the wall and send the ball into the goal.
Race.label: Type the text above
Race.help: Mistakes? Backspace to correct them. Only a correct sequence moves your car.
Race.finished: Text complete. Ball in the net. Nicely done.

ErrorPages.notFoundDescription: This page doesn’t exist, or this race code doesn’t lead to any race.
ErrorPages.serverErrorDescription: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

Garage.title: Garage
